name: Rio Claro

queries.query: Rio Claro SP cadastral parcel map land registry official GIS municipal cadastre
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Rio Claro Municipal Government pages for the Planning Secretariat and the public services portal, plus the municipality's municipal tax portal. Official municipal legislation/search evidence identifies a municipal cadastro imobiliário and cadastro/geoprocessamento function, but no anonymous parcel map or parcel API was exposed by the public pages inspected.

queries.query: Rio Claro SP cadastro imobiliário mapa cadastral lotes prefeitura geoprocessamento oficial
queries.result: A pesquisa em português encontrou the Prefeitura de Rio Claro pages for Secretaria de Planejamento, the Portal de Serviços, and the municipal IPTU/tax service reference. The official municipal material describes cadastro imobiliário, atualização da base cartográfica, and cadastro/geoprocessamento responsibilities, but did not provide a public anonymous parcel geometry route.

registryEvidence.custodian: Prefeitura Municipal de Rio Claro, Secretaria de Planejamento, Gestão e Desenvolvimento Urbano; municipal Departamento de Cadastro e Geoprocessamento / Cadastro Imobiliário

registryEvidence.scopeNote: Official municipal material evidences a local cadastral custodian and cadastral/geoprocessing responsibilities. It does not evidence an open citywide parcel geometry service or complete parcel coverage. The municipal tax portal is a property-record/payment route and was not used to request unsafe property data.
